title: PipeshubTurnLabel
description: A turn's confidentiality label (P2.5a, REPORT 6.5.1): the records and live items whose content reached the turn's answer, as the typed sources a viewer's access is decided on (C-18). complete is false when some content of unknown provenance reached it; such a turn is shown to nobody but its actor. A web page is public and never named. More than 2000 sources is recorded as unknown (complete false, no sources). Who may read each source is never copied here: it is decided from the platform's permissions when a viewer asks.

integrity.description: SEC-B-05 (ADR-MEM-01): who could have written what reached the turn, besides whether a viewer may read it. external: content an outsider can write (a web page, an outsider's email or chat, an MCP result, a fetched repository) reached it; first_party: only the organization's own content did. A join is external when any part is, first_party only when every part says so. Absent: the writer predates it, or a part of the join did not say; a memory the turn proposed then waits for its owner's review, as for external.
